description.zh: 索引生命周期策略名称。
description.en: The name of the index lifecycle policy.

title.zh: 删除索引生命周期策略

descriptions.zh: > 您无法删除当前正在使用的策略。如果该策略正用于管理任一索引，则请求将失败并返回错误。
descriptions.en: > You cannot delete a policy that is currently in use. If the policy is being used to manage any index, the request fails and returns an error.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch delete-ilm-policy --instance-id es-cn-nif24adwc00820000 --policy-name slm-history-ilm-policy --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
